data.credibility: Management guidance history is unavailable in the ledger. However, foundational execution is supported by strong historical financial compounding, robust branch expansion exceeding 8,500 branches, and diverse business segments spanning retail, wholesale, and financial services.
bull: Revenue compounded at 22.1% annually over five years, with acceleration to 26.9% over three years, showing robust fundamental momentum.
Extensive branch network exceeding 8,500 branches as of March 31, 2026, provides a massive and reliable deposit-gathering franchise.
Strong trailing twelve months net profit of ₹83,685 cr on revenue of ₹359,956 cr highlights strong operational scale.
bear: Return on Equity stands at a modest 13.6% alongside a ROCE of 7.02%, reflecting capital efficiency constraints.
The bank relies on borrowings and deposits as raw material for its lending operations, exposing margins to funding costs.
Valuation stands at a P/E multiple of 16.3 against a backdrop of moderate profitability metrics and heavy capital intensity.
